spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (नटति नाटयति)
1 To dance, to dance as an actor, to act.
2 To drop or fall.
3 To shake, to move slightly.
4 To injure.
5 To shine.

m. (-टः)
1 A dancer, a mime, an actor, a Nut, &c. in modern times: in caste, the son of a degraded Kṣatriya by a woman of the second caste.
4 A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or latterly called A. karka, Roxburgh's Catalogue); also नड and नल.
5 A subordinate mode of music.
f. (-टा)
A sort of shrub, (Cæsalpinia bonduccella.)
(-टी)
1 A medicinal plant: see नली.
2 A whore.
3 A Nach girl, a dancer, an actress.
4 Red arsenick: see नली.
5 A Rāgiṇī.
E.
नट to dance, affix अच्, and टाप् or ङीष्; otherwise, नश to destroy, Uṇādi affix डट, &c.

n. (-टं)
1 Dancing, acting.
2 The Carnatic.
E.
नट to dance, affix घञ्.

n. (-नः)
The art or act of dancing, pantomime, &c.
E.
नट to dance, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-णः)
A Rāga or mode of music, according to some, the sixth, or to others, a subdivision of Dīpaka or of Megha.
E.
नट, and नारायण VIṢṆU: the supreme with dancers, &c.

n. (-र्णं)
Skin.

f. (-का)
The egg-plant (Solanum melongena.)

n. (-नं)
Yellow orpiment.
E.
नट an actor, and मण्डन adorning; dying theatrical raiment.

m. (-रः)
A chief dancer or actor.
E.
नट, and वर best.

m. (-कः)
1 Yellow orpiment.
2 An actor, a dancer, &c.
E.
नट an actor, सज्ञा a name, affix कन्.

m. (-ष्ठः)
A chief or excellent dancer or actor.
E.
नट, and श्रेष्ठ best.

f. (-का)
Shame, modesty.
E.
नट dancing, and अन्त destroying, affix कन् and टाप्; it is also read नटान्धिका.

m. (-रः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
नट a dancer, and ईश्वर a deity, the god of the dancers.

m. (-कः-की-कं)
An actor, acting, dancing, &c.
m. (-कः)
A play, a drama: the first of the ten species of dramatic compositions of the first order.
f. (-की)
The court of INDRA.
E.
नट to act or perform, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-ञ्चः)
Course or arrangement of a drama.
E.
नाटक and प्रपञ्च extent.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Dramatic.
E.
नाटक, and छ aff.

m. (-म्रः)
The water melon, (Cucurbita citrullus.)

m. (-रः)
The son of an actress.

f. (-का)
A short or light comedy, the first of the Uparūpakas or dramas of the second order.
E.
नट to dance, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-यः)
The son of an actress.
E.
नटी, and ढक् aff.

m. (-रः)
The son of an actress or dancing girl.
E.
नटी, an actress, द्रक् aff.

n. (-ट्यं)
The science or art of dancing or acting, or the union of song, dance, and instrumental musick.
E.
नट to dance, affix ण्यत् or ज्य.

m. (-कः)
Rules of dramatic representation.
E.
नाट्य acting, धर्म्म rule, and ठक् aff.

m. (-यः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
नाट्य dancing, and प्रिय fond of.

f. (-ला)
A theatre, a building for dramatic exhibitions; according to some it should be built near the gate of a palace.
E.
नाट्य, and शाला a hall.

f. (-क्तिः)
Dramatic phraseology.
E.
नाट्य, and उक्ति expression.
